title: Food
blurb: Where our favorite foods come from and the science of cooking.

hr.title: Hrana
hr.blurb: Odakle dolazi naša omiljena hrana i znanost kuhanja.

questions.fact: Tomatoes reached Europe only after Columbus's voyages. Later they became a star of Italian cooking.

hr.q: Gdje su rajčice prvi put rasle?
hr.fact: Rajčice su do Europe stigle tek nakon Kolumbovih putovanja. Poslije su postale zvijezde talijanske kuhinje.

questions.q: Potatoes were first farmed in which mountains?
questions.fact: Potatoes traveled from South America to Europe, where they became a key crop in places like Ireland.

hr.q: U kojim se planinama krumpir prvi put uzgajao?
hr.fact: Krumpir je iz Južne Amerike stigao u Europu, gdje je postao važna kultura u zemljama poput Irske.

questions.q: True or false: Sealed honey can stay safe to eat for a very long time.
questions.fact: Honey is low in water and acidic, so germs have a very hard time growing in it.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: zatvoren med može ostati jestiv jako dugo.
hr.fact: Med ima malo vode i kiseo je, pa se mikrobi u njemu teško razmnožavaju.

questions.fact: Sushi is about the vinegar rice, not raw fish. Some kinds use cooked fish or only vegetables.

hr.fact: Kod sushija je glavna riža s octom, a ne sirova riba. Neke vrste imaju kuhanu ribu ili samo povrće.

questions.q: What is the main ingredient in guacamole?
questions.fact: Avocados first grew in Mexico and Central America, and guacamole goes back to the Aztecs.

hr.fact: Avokado potječe iz Meksika i Srednje Amerike, a guacamole seže sve do Asteka.

questions.q: Chocolate is made from the seeds of which plant?
questions.fact: The ancient Maya and Aztecs made a bitter, spicy drink from cacao long before chocolate bars existed.

hr.q: Od sjemenki koje biljke nastaje čokolada?
hr.fact: Drevni Maje i Asteci pili su gorak, ljut napitak od kakaa davno prije čokoladica.

questions.q: Oranges are famous for having lots of which vitamin?
questions.fact: Sailors once carried citrus fruit on long trips to stay healthy, because vitamin C keeps gums and skin strong.

hr.q: Naranče su poznate po tome što imaju puno kojeg vitamina?
hr.fact: Mornari su nekad na duga putovanja nosili agrume, jer vitamin C čuva zdrave desni i kožu.

questions.q: Why does a popcorn kernel pop?
questions.fact: Steam builds pressure inside the hard shell until it bursts, and the soft starch puffs out.

hr.q: Zašto zrno kukuruza za kokice pukne?
hr.fact: Para stvara pritisak u tvrdoj ljusci dok ona ne pukne, a mekani se škrob napuhne prema van.

questions.q: Kimchi is a famous dish from which country?
questions.fact: Kimchi is made of fermented vegetables, often napa cabbage with garlic and chili.

hr.q: Kimchi je poznato jelo iz koje zemlje?
hr.fact: Kimchi je fermentirano povrće, najčešće kineski kupus s češnjakom i čilijem.

questions.q: Peanuts are not true nuts. What are they?
questions.fact: Peanuts grow underground and belong to the same family as beans and peas.

hr.q: Kikiriki nije pravi orašasti plod. Što je onda?
hr.fact: Kikiriki raste pod zemljom i pripada istoj porodici kao grah i grašak.
